title: Maya Chen
text: Chemist Maya Chen discovered the blue mineral asterite. She studied at Ravel Institute.

title: Ravel Institute
text: Ravel Institute is a research university located in the city of Norwick.

title: Ivo Marin
text: Novelist Ivo Marin wrote The Silent Meridian. He graduated from Beacon College.

title: Beacon College
text: Beacon College is an independent university in the coastal city of Selene.

title: Lena Ortiz
text: Engineer Lena Ortiz designed the Argo turbine after studying at Cedar Polytechnic.

title: Cedar Polytechnic
text: Cedar Polytechnic has its main campus in the city of Velin.

title: Tomas Vale
text: Explorer Tomas Vale mapped the Oris caves. Vale trained at Meridian Academy.

title: Meridian Academy
text: Meridian Academy is based in the mountain city of Arken.

title: Nira Sol
text: Astronomer Nira Sol identified comet Lumen and attended Horizon University.

title: Horizon University
text: Horizon University is located in the city of Darsen beside Lake Miro.

title: Oren Voss
text: Composer Oren Voss created the opera Glass Harbor and studied at Amber Conservatory.

title: Amber Conservatory
text: Amber Conservatory is a music school in the city of Caldor.

title: Rina Hale
text: Biologist Rina Hale classified the fern silvara. Hale was educated at Pine University.

title: Pine University
text: Pine University occupies a historic campus in the city of Eston.

title: Eli Ward
text: Architect Eli Ward designed the Crescent Library and attended Stonebridge School.

title: Stonebridge School
text: Stonebridge School is an architecture college in the city of Brin.

title: University cities
text: Many researchers attend a university in a city before making a discovery. Their college location may differ from their birthplace.

title: Scientific discoveries
text: A discovery can be named after a scientist, a city, a mineral, a comet, or a university.

title: Norwick Harbor
text: Norwick Harbor is known for shipbuilding and coastal mineral trading.

title: Selene Observatory
text: Selene Observatory studies comets and trains visiting university researchers.
